  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (B : ℝ)
  (k : ℕ),
  ∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) ≤ B →
    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v → 3 ≤ u_lim.tree.adj.degree v + k) →
      let P := Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v };
      let G := Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v };
      ↑P * th.h ≤ B ∧
        (1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V → G ≤ P + k - 2) ∧ ↑(Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) ≤ 1 ⊔ (2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ + ↑k - 2)

doc: Generalized component count bound for $k$-marked stable sphere trees ($k \ge 0$).

  {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} {M : Type u_3} {inst_3 : MetricSpace M} {inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M}
  {inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M} {inst_6 : CompactSpace M} {inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M}
  {u_seq : ℕ → ↑GromovCompactness.CP1 → M} {u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I}
  {σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap} {frames : u_lim.tree.V → ℕ → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame}
  {smooth_conv :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (↑σ n) ∘ ⇑(frames v n).toHomeo) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {z | ∃ w, ∃ (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w), z = u_lim.tree.node_point v w h})}
  {frame_collapse :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w),
      ∀ K ⊆ GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯},
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => ⇑((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K}
  {energy_conv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (↑σ n))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))}
  {σ_1 : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap} {frames_1 : u_lim.tree.V → ℕ → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame}
  {smooth_conv_1 :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (↑σ_1 n) ∘ ⇑(frames_1 v n).toHomeo) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {z | ∃ w, ∃ (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w), z = u_lim.tree.node_point v w h})}
  {frame_collapse_1 :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w),
      ∀ K ⊆ GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯},
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => ⇑((frames_1 v n).inv.comp (frames_1 w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K}
  {energy_conv_1 :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (↑σ_1 n))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))},
  { σ := σ, frames := frames, smooth_conv := smooth_conv, frame_collapse := frame_collapse,
        energy_conv := energy_conv } =
      { σ := σ_1, frames := frames_1, smooth_conv := smooth_conv_1, frame_collapse := frame_collapse_1,
        energy_conv := energy_conv_1 } →
    σ = σ_1 ∧ frames = frames_1
name: GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness.mk.inj

  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (ε_reg C_reg : ℝ),
  0 < ε_reg →
    0 < C_reg →
      (∀ (u : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1 → M) (a : ℂ) (r : ℝ),
          0 < r →
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r) < ε_reg →
                ∀ z ∈ GromovCompactness.disk_at a (r / 2),
                  GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z ≤
                    C_reg * r ^ (-2) * GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) →
        ∀ (ε_sph : ℝ),
          0 < ε_sph →
            (∀ (u : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1 → M),
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  (¬∃ c, ∀ (z : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1), u z = c) → ε_sph ≤ GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u) →
              ∀ (C_neck a_decay ε_neck : ℝ),
                0 < C_neck →
                  0 < a_decay →
                    0 < ε_neck →
                      (∀ (u : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1 → M) (center : ℂ) (r R : ℝ),
                          0 < r →
                            2 * r < R →
                              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                                GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R) < ε_neck →
                                  ∀ (r₁ r₂ : ℝ),
                                    r < r₁ →
                                      r₁ < r₂ →
                                        r₂ < R →
                                          GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂) ≤
                                            C_neck * ((r / r₁) ^ a_decay + (r₂ / R) ^ a_decay) *
                                              GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                                (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)) →
                        Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.exists_target_thresholds_of_modules
doc:
Zero-sorry reduction theorem: Given the geometric modules A03, A07, and A10,
the universal positive bubbling threshold exists constructively.

type:

  (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (B : ℝ),
  ∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) ≤ B →
    let P := Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v };
    let G := Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v };
    ↑P * th.h ≤ B ∧
      (1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V → G + 2 ≤ P ∧ Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V + 2 ≤ 2 * P) ∧
        ↑(Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) ≤ 1 ⊔ (2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ - 2)

doc:
**Universal Component Count Bounds (Contract G04 & Theorem 1)**.
For any stable sphere tree limit of total energy $\le B$:
1. $P \cdot h \le B$, so $P \le \lfloor B / h \rfloor$.
2. If $|V| > 1$, then $G \le P - 2$ and $|V| \le 2P - 2$.
3. Universally across all configurations (including single curves $|V| = 1$), the safe integer bound
   $$(|V| : \mathbb{Z}) \le \max(1, 2\lfloor B / h \rfloor - 2)$$
   holds without natural subtraction truncation artifacts.

  1 < Fintype.card lim.tree.V →

        G ≤ P - 2 ∧ Fintype.card lim.tree.V ≤ 2 * P - 2
name: GromovCompactness.ghost_components_bound
doc:
The Ghost Component Bound Theorem (`gromov_compactness.pdf` Theorem 1 & Task `F06`):
In any stable sphere tree with $|V| > 1$, let $P$ be the number of non-constant components
and $G$ be the number of ghost components ($|V| = P + G$).
For unmarked curves ($k = 0$):
1. $G \le P - 2$
2. $|V| = P + G \le 2P - 2$.
In particular, the total number of components is linearly bounded by the number of non-constant components.
(For general $k$-marked curves, $G \le P + k - 2$ and $|V| \le \max(1, 2P + k - 2) \le \max(1, 2\lfloor B/h \rfloor + k - 2)$).

  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : ℕ}

  {u_lim : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit I k} [inst_8 : SizeOf E] [inst_9 : SizeOf H]
  [inst_10 : SizeOf M] (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
  (frames : u_lim.tree.V → ℕ → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (smooth_conv :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => (u_seq (↑σ n)).map ∘ ⇑(frames v n).toHomeo) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {z | ∃ w, ∃ (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w), z = u_lim.tree.node_point v w h}))
  (frame_collapse :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w),
      ∀ K ⊆ GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯},
        IsCompact K →

  (mark_conv :
    ∀ (i : Fin k),

        (nhds (u_lim.mark_point i)))
  (energy_conv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (↑σ n)).map) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim))),
  sizeOf
      { σ := σ, frames := frames, smooth_conv := smooth_conv, frame_collapse := frame_collapse, mark_conv := mark_conv,

    1 + sizeOf σ

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {H : Type u_2} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H]

  (self : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (v : self.tree.V),
  (∃ c, ∀ (z : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1), self.map v z = c) → 3 ≤ self.tree.adj.degree v
name: GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit.stable
doc:
Stability condition for unmarked curves ($k = 0$): any component on which $u_v$ is constant
("ghost bubble") must have at least 3 special points (nodal attachments) $\operatorname{deg}(v) \ge 3$
so that its biholomorphic automorphism group in $\operatorname{PSL}(2, \mathbb{C})$ fixing nodal points is finite.
Note on unmarked vs marked curves:
- For unmarked curves ($k = 0$, the primary track of this formalization), special points are strictly nodal points,
  so $\operatorname{deg}_{\text{nodal}}(v) \ge 3$.
- For $k$-marked curves ($k > 0$, extension track E03/E04), marked points also stabilize ghost spheres;
  the general stability condition is $\operatorname{deg}_{\text{nodal}}(v) + k_v \ge 3$, where $k_v$ is the number
  of marked points on component $v$. Under that condition, a ghost component may have nodal degree 0, 1, or 2.

  (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (u_seq : ℕ → ↑GromovCompactness.CP1 → M) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I),
  GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      ∀ (A_area : ℝ),
        (∀ (n : ℕ), GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ = A_area) →
          GromovCompactness.Extensions.treeSymplecticArea I u_lim = A_area ∧
            GromovCompactness.sphereTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim = A_area
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.symplectic_area_identity_of_const_area
doc:
**Symplectic Area Identity for Sequences with Constant Area (Zero-sorry)**.
If a sequence of $J$-holomorphic curves has constant symplectic area $\mathcal{A}$
(such as curves representing a fixed homology class $[u_n] = A$), then the limit tree
satisfies the exact area identity:
$$\mathcal{A} = \sum_{v \in V(T)} \int_{S^2} u_{\infty, v}^* \omega = \sum_{v \in V(T)} E(u_{\infty, v}).$$

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {H : Type u_2} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H]
  (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  [inst_8 : T2Space M],
  (∀ (u : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1 → M) (p : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {p}) →
        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u) (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {p}) ≠ ⊤ →
          ∃ u_ext, Continuous u_ext ∧ Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {p})) →
    (∀ (u_ext : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1 → M) (p : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1),
        Continuous u_ext →
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_ext (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {p}) →
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_ext Set.univ) →
      (∀ (p : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1), Dense (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {p})) →
        ∀ (u : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1 → M) (p : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {p}) →
            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u) (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {p}) ≠ ⊤ →
              ∃! u_smooth,
                Set.EqOn u_smooth u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {p}) ∧
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_smooth Set.univ

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {H : Type u_2} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H]
  {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : ℕ}
  {u_seq : ℕ → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k}
  {u_lim : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit I k} (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
  (frames : u_lim.tree.V → ℕ → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (smooth_conv :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => (u_seq (↑σ n)).map ∘ ⇑(frames v n).toHomeo) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {z | ∃ w, ∃ (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w), z = u_lim.tree.node_point v w h}))
  (frame_collapse :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w),
      ∀ K ⊆ GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯},
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => ⇑((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (mark_conv :
    ∀ (i : Fin k),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (frames (u_lim.mark_vertex i) n).inv.toHomeo ((u_seq (↑σ n)).points i)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (u_lim.mark_point i)))
  (energy_conv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (↑σ n)).map) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim)))
  (σ_1 : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (frames_1 : u_lim.tree.V → ℕ → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (smooth_conv_1 :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => (u_seq (↑σ_1 n)).map ∘ ⇑(frames_1 v n).toHomeo) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {z | ∃ w, ∃ (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w), z = u_lim.tree.node_point v w h}))
  (frame_collapse_1 :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w),
      ∀ K ⊆ GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere {u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯},
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => ⇑((frames_1 v n).inv.comp (frames_1 w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (mark_conv_1 :
    ∀ (i : Fin k),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (frames_1 (u_lim.mark_vertex i) n).inv.toHomeo ((u_seq (↑σ_1 n)).points i)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (u_lim.mark_point i)))
  (energy_conv_1 :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (↑σ_1 n)).map) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim))),
  ({ σ := σ, frames := frames, smooth_conv := smooth_conv, frame_collapse := frame_collapse, mark_conv := mark_conv,
        energy_conv := energy_conv } =
      { σ := σ_1, frames := frames_1, smooth_conv := smooth_conv_1, frame_collapse := frame_collapse_1,
        mark_conv := mark_conv_1, energy_conv := energy_conv_1 }) =
    (σ = σ_1 ∧ frames = frames_1)
